newnario: On the way to R-F17, Viktor Newnario tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Viktor Newnario watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Dawn watch. Viktor Newnario put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram, grazed.
the_ghost_of_sky: Severin Sky arrived at R-F9 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam corrected the cap; the first puddle corrected the rest.
Felix Varsikasikra taught Severin Sky to play the harmonica. The bay has asked them both, formally, to stop.
Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Severin Sky stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Severin Sky got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.
vitocarcioppolo: Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp arrived on Day 4 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
